ad.fieldHelp: Letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens only; it cannot start with a number. Existing fields are never overwritten.
ad.fixedDescription: Always use the selected advertisement. If it is disabled or outside its delivery window, no advertisement is injected.
ad.loadFailed: Advertisement options failed to load. Automatic selection remains available.
ad.randomDescription: Each response randomly selects one enabled API advertisement that is currently within its delivery window.
ad.title: JSON advertisement delivery

cache.defaultTtlHelp: Used when no rule matches. Set to 0 to skip caching. Maximum 86400 seconds.
cache.failOpen: Redis read or write failures fall back to the upstream service without interrupting the request. API keys are excluded and advertisements are injected after cache lookup.
cache.title: Open gateway response cache

timeout.help: The entire interface call, including all polling nodes, shares this request budget. An explicit interface timeout takes priority and may exceed the global value; 0 inherits the global timeout.
timeout.inheritedHelp: This interface inherits the global timeout. The effective value is {0} ms.
timeout.title: Upstream request timeout

description: Configure response cache conditions, upstream timeout, and JSON advertisement injection per API. Admin-side API debugging always connects directly to the upstream service.
globalDescription: Configure the default response cache, request timeout, and JSON advertisement strategy inherited by APIs without a matching interface override.

inheritance.description: Cache, request timeout, and advertisement inheritance are controlled independently for this API.
inheritance.inheritedHelp: Disabled override sections inherit the latest global strategy. Local values are retained and become effective again when the override is enabled.
inheritance.title: Policy priority

messages.fixedAdRequired: Select the API advertisement to deliver
messages.invalidField: The advertisement JSON field name is invalid
messages.invalidTimeout: Request timeout must be between 100 and 120000 milliseconds
messages.invalidInterfaceTimeout: Request timeout must be 0 (inherit global), or 100 to 120000 milliseconds

rules.empty: No condition rules. Only the default cache duration will be used.
rules.name: Rule name
rules.title: Conditional cache rules

title: Delivery and cache policy
